description: Redacted placeholder vocabulary shared by all fixtures. No real paths, users, tokens, charges or repository content.
eventIdDerivation: sha256:<hex sha256 of adapterId + U+0000 + upstreamKey + U+0000 + kind>
rules: Every event origin is fixture; fixtures never masquerade as live or imported.
Unavailable values are null with a reason or gap; zero means a measured zero.
Estimated values carry method estimated in fieldSemantics and are never summed with source-reported values.
The synthetic secret canary appears only in core-secret-canary and must never appear in any output.
